# Copilot Instructions for Immerge

## About This Repository

Immerge is a project developed by Flypaper Creative.

## Coding Standards

- Write clean, maintainable code
- Follow existing code patterns and conventions in the repository
- Keep changes minimal and focused on the specific issue being addressed

## Working with This Repository

- Always explore the repository structure before making changes
- Run tests before and after making changes to ensure nothing breaks
- Make small, incremental commits with clear commit messages
- Follow existing architectural patterns and design decisions

## Best Practices

- Prioritize code readability and maintainability
- Add comments only when necessary to explain complex logic
- Keep dependencies minimal and up to date
- Ensure all changes are properly tested
